content: Report file naming convention: reports are named report_YYYYMMDD_platform.txt (the date without separators, then the lowercase team name platform).
Backups are named backup-YYYY-MM-DD.tar.gz and stored in the archive bucket.
The platform team's standup is at 10:00 on weekdays.
Prefer small commits when refactoring the report generator.
Release notes live in docs/releases and are written per minor version.
Dana reviews anything that touches the nightly job.
